summary: CCC-built 99-ft 9-in steel tower erected in 1934; moved to a new site in 1962-64 after its lease expired. No current status found.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 99-foot 9-inch steel tower with a two-room tower house, at a cost of $1,422.87.
Lease expired; a new site was acquired and the 100-foot tower moved. The listing dates this 1962-64.

evidence.supports: Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 99-foot 9-inch steel tower with a two-room tower house in September 1934
evidence.quote: September 1934: The Civilian Conservation Corps erected a 99-foot 9-inch steel tower along with a 2-room tower house at a cost of $1,422.87.

evidence.supports: Costs funded through the Emergency Conservation Works program
evidence.quote: The costs were funded through the Emergency Conservation Works program.

evidence.supports: Listing cites the state's 6th Biennial Report for 1934-36 for the 1934 figures
evidence.quote: Department of Conservation and Development - 6th Biennial Report 1934-36

evidence.supports: Lease expired; new site acquired; 100-foot tower moved, 1962-64
evidence.quote: 1962-64: Due to the expiration of the lease, a new site was acquired and the 100-foot tower moved.

evidence.supports: Agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources, Wilson County
evidence.quote: WILSON Wilson County - North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: Tower list places Wilson at 35.72527, -77.99583 in Wilson County

notes_for_editor: All build and move facts come from one secondary listing that quotes state biennial reports (1934-36 and 1964); those reports were not read. Height is 99 ft 9 in in 1934 but 100 ft after the move; likely rounding, unconfirmed. The tnlandforms coordinates may be the moved site rather than the 1934 site. Two searches found no current Wilson tower record, and the ECU and DigitalNC pages I tried were unreadable. Status and access are unknown.
